conclusion.scope: Source contract only. No current production run, template, configured W or release readiness is asserted.

paths.finding: daemonTracer.configure(config.tracing,{version:DAEMON_VERSION}) supplies package daemon version, not canonical worker W. The frozen source_correlation query's service.version field cannot by itself become a W attestation.
paths.queryBoundary: Query field limitation was supplied by Root; this review did not execute or rewrite the 14 frozen SQL queries.

paths.finding: Owner-scoped run evidence returns run id/status/bot/issue/model/harness/profile/routing/executionIdentity and capture/artifact metadata, with no workerSha, sourceCommit or template. The driver's runProof projects model/profile/owner runtime facts only.

Existing ordinary evidence reads do not return or preserve W. The cleanup POST ends a checked exact run. Machine-view GET is only on the cleanup404/not-created fallback; a null value then proves no machine under that branch, not what W executed.

Existing deployment catalogue includes sourceCommit, workerSha, and desktop/claude/codex template IDs. Parser requires W/source and selected template env pins to match. e2b-runtime selectedTemplate requires the configured additive template to be the matching preinstalled/base kind.

The already-required startup operation reads root marker /opt/mikka/worker-source-sha or a bootstrap-broker sourceSha, then verifies it equals configured MIKKA_CLOUD_WORKER_SHA. Runtime-refresh verifies the post-switch marker again. The misleading local name sourceSha here is the marker W, not App source M.

Existing stream attestation carries version, exact runId/leaseId, sourceSha and broker mode. It checks current release capability, marker and worker-ready binding. This is consumed inside the startup operation; the current driver and public run evidence do not persist this attestation.

Release-owned source and files must be trusted; capability.workerSha, root marker and worker-ready.sha match expected W before new notice mode. The private registration notice itself binds exact deviceId/workspaceId/token digest, not W. Legacy fallback still occurs only after existing worker-marker verification in thread-machines.

Root-owned installed release realpath supplies sourceCommit; immutable marker supplies W. A local preloaded-models receipt stores both with validated model metadata. It is not an existing per-run API or PostHog field; do not claim the driver already exports it.

Current startup spans/logs preserve hashed run identity and bounded stage/time records. They do not export W, sourceCommit or template ID. A logged phase/end alone is not a numeric W receipt; use actual success and the source contract carefully.

Existing owner GET /api/mobile/threads/:id/machine can expose cloud.sandboxId and template from snapshotId. It chooses the latest chain member with a machine and does not return that selected runId. It may serve a live single-run/otherwise independently-bound chain observation, but must not be relabelled as an exact historical-run attestation.
Existing opt-in bootstrap evidence returns authority:none/device/workspace/harness/hint, not W or template. It is not a substitute for released runtime identity.

reuse: The actual R7 immutable release/candidate evidence that maps runtime source R and W to exact template IDs.
The actual production deployment's existing configured runtime readback; it should preserve the same W and template mapping.
The case's existing exact run identity/model/harness/profile evidence and actual successful startup/registration/claim chain.
minimumNoNewPollingEvidence.possibleOptionalExistingRead: If a direct template observation is required, one normal owner machine-view GET may capture template/sandbox while the relevant machine exists, but its chain-selection limitation must be retained. This is a plan only; no read was made.
minimumNoNewPollingEvidence.interpretation: Combining release/configuration evidence with successful execution through the mandatory exact-W bootstrap guard is a source-supported binding inference. It is not a newly observed per-run W field. Keep raw W unknown in current report fields that do not carry it.
forbiddenSubstitutions: App source M equals runtime source R is not required.
A phase log or a machine:null cleanup response is not direct proof of the executed worker hash.
No new PID equality requirement, DB polling, provider command or driver rewrite is proposed.
